Vietnamese dishes with very cheep price ! (western food available too)
Mar 2024 • Solo
It was challenging to find a place to eat with a glass of wine in Can Tho. 
I am a solo traveler and it is not easy to finish a bottle of wine by myself. 
Mekong 1965 is one of the very few places where I could do it !
I wish I had found Mekong 1965 on Day 1.

I stayed in Can Tho only for 2 nights, I had a chance to dine out in Mekong 1965 only one time.
I wish they were open for lunch time too. Their opening time is 1500 ~  unfortunately.

Variety of Vietnamese dishes with very reasonable prices, this is really my place.

When I ate dinner, I ordered Vietnamese crepe (Banh Xeo) . I liked it but after I ordered, I found that they serve slow cooked caramelized pork or something. 
Dah !  I wanted to try that one but they are open only from 1500,,,,,

The next time I visit Can Tho, I will definitely go back to Mekong 1965.
It is not a lux place at all but very relaxing spot like speakeasy bar,,

Their food might not be the best but I like the atmosphere.

First-class tacos, burritos and quesadillas

Located on the promenade (Hai Ba Trung) Ninh Kieu Kai). Mekong Restaurant 1965 is a small, cozy restaurant and a popular meeting place for locals, tourists and resident expats. In addition to traditional Vietnamese and international dishes, the restaurant also serves first-class tacos, burritos, nachos and quesadillas to eat in or take away. The service is very friendly and speaks English, which is not a given for Vietnam. Our rating 5/5

Not just local food, a great choice of different cuisines. Good food at a reasonable price
Mar 2023 • Couples
Small restaurant with outside tables. Nice atmosphere with a mixture of locals, ex-pats and tourist customers.

Although this is listed as a Vietnamese restaurant, what attracted us was the choice of different cuisines (especially for a small restaurant). After 2 weeks of eating (great) local food, we just fancied eating something different. In addition to Asian food, steaks, burgers, sandwiches, pasta and pancakes were on offer but we opted for pizza and tacos, which were really tasty. 

The drinks and the food were reasonably priced. Service was good and friendly.
